metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the short loaf, Trinity Sunday, one turning of the glass, the Counter at the step, and the late line about a door.

yesterday: The loaf is still a thumb short of the notch, and still a penny. Yesterday's butter was fourpence.
The powers that be are ordained of God. Masters are to keep their servants in. He set the glass down after one turning, as he did on Whitsunday.
Halberds stood at the Mayor's door. Verbeke sat with the house. If he is asked, he is from Norwich.
A neighbour, on the step, heard that apprentices took the prisoners out of the Counter in the Poultry. Mistress Ansell has the street door.
Yesterday the butter was fourpence. Her sentence tonight was butter, then a prison. The three sheets are still on the board.
